verdict.rationale: Kit publishes a structured, per-endpoint V4 API reference covering broadcasts, custom fields, and accounts. AI agents can explore it through the Kit Developer Docs MCP and llms.txt. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or includes runnable examples, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
